base_path.description: The same directory as `mat`'s; a run directory not below it is refused with `bad_path`.

exec_timeout_ms.description: The cap of one run; a caller's `timeout_ms` only lowers it. At the cap the program's process group is killed and the run answers `exit: 'timeout'`. Keep `external_timeout_ms` above it and `cell.message_timeout` above that.

env_path.description: PATH of the program; the whole environment is PATH, HOME and LANG=C.UTF-8.

env_home.description: HOME of the program; empty means `base_path`.

description.purpose: Starts one program in a workspace directory: argv without a shell, cwd below `base_path`, an environment of PATH, HOME and LANG only, a time cap; answers the exit code (or 'timeout') and the last 8 KiB of stdout and stderr. The program inherits this cell's sandbox: no network, write access to `base_path` alone.
description.not_in_scope: No check of `exec_allow` (`./mat` asked before anything was laid out), no scan of what the program wrote.
